workflow_steps.explanation: Ensure you're starting from the latest main branch
Modern syntax to create and switch to new branch. Uses descriptive naming: feature/user-authentication

commands:
git commit -m "feat: add user authentication endpoints

- Implement login and logout endpoints
- Add JWT token generation
- Create user session management

Closes #123"
workflow_steps.explanation: Use interactive staging (-p) to review changes. Follow Conventional Commits (feat:) with detailed body
Push branch and set upstream tracking (-u flag)

commands: gh pr create --title "feat: Add user authentication" --body "Implements user authentication with JWT tokens. Closes #123"
workflow_steps.explanation: Create PR on GitHub or using gh CLI

pr_guidelines: Keep PRs focused and reasonably sized

safety_notes: Always pull from main before creating feature branch
Use --force-with-lease instead of --force if you need to force push
Review changes with 'git diff --staged' before committing
Never commit secrets or sensitive data
next_steps: Address review comments in new commits
Once approved, merge using GitHub's merge button (or rebase and merge)
